name: Indo Count Industries Ltd
tagline: World's largest home-textile bed-linen exporter by volume, but weak returns (ROE ~5.5% TTM) and a rich ~58x P/E on only ~10.4% five-year revenue growth undercut the bullish external-lead thesis.
business_overview: Indo Count Industries is a global home-textile company specialising in bed linen, fashion bedding, utility bedding and institutional bedding, exporting largely to the US/EU from India. Seeded via untrusted X triage (@rdkriplani, bullish view, medium conviction, 2026-09-13).
fundamentals_narrative: Indo Count is genuinely the largest global player in its niche (bed linen), which is the basis for the bullish external lead, but the numbers this pass do not support a strong conviction case: ROCE (~8.2%) and ROE (~5.5% TTM, ~11.2% 3-yr average) are weak for the market to be pricing the stock at ~58x trailing earnings, and 5-year revenue growth (~10.4%) is described by screener data as 'poor'. A China+1/US-tariff-driven order-shift tailwind to Indian home-textile exporters is plausible in principle but no specific named contract win, capacity expansion, or margin inflection was found this pass to substantiate it for this company specifically.
